title: Week Summary: Evaluation, Communication, and Professional Practice

concepts.name: Architecture evaluation
concepts.description: The assessment of whether an architecture satisfies important concerns, scenarios, constraints, and quality goals.

concepts.name: ATAM
concepts.description: Architecture Tradeoff Analysis Method, a structured scenario-based method for analyzing architectural risks and tradeoffs.

concepts.name: Sensitivity point
concepts.description: An architectural decision or parameter where small changes can strongly affect a quality attribute.

concepts.name: Tradeoff point
concepts.description: An architectural decision that affects multiple quality attributes in competing ways.

concepts.name: Architecture narrative
concepts.description: A coherent explanation of the system context, major decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and consequences.

concepts.name: Audience adaptation
concepts.description: Changing architecture communication to match stakeholder knowledge, decisions, and concerns.

concepts.name: Architecture briefing
concepts.description: A concise presentation or walkthrough of architecture information for a particular audience.

concepts.name: Decision framing
concepts.description: Presenting architectural choices in terms of options, consequences, evidence, and stakeholder impact.

concepts.name: Capstone architecture package
concepts.description: A final course artifact combining architecture scope, views, decisions, perspectives, risks, and evaluation evidence.

concepts.name: Architecture coherence
concepts.description: The degree to which views, decisions, rationale, scenarios, and constraints tell a consistent architectural story.

concepts.name: Risk register
concepts.description: A maintained list of architectural risks, impacts, owners, mitigation actions, and status.

concepts.name: Architecture presentation
concepts.description: A structured communication of architecture decisions, tradeoffs, and evidence to stakeholders.
